subtitle: Talent Intelligence — Hero Paths & Build Comparison
changes: Introduced hero-talent tree selection using the actual hero groups supplied by Blizzard for the selected specialization
Added saved-build comparison showing changed nodes and planned rank additions and reductions
Highlighted talent nodes that have more or fewer planned ranks than the chosen saved draft
Displayed Blizzard-provided default_points values without presenting them as manually earned points
Added a safe compact-layout fallback when Blizzard positions are unavailable, duplicated or outside supported grid bounds
Protected against stale region/index fetch results changing the active specialization list
Preserved the v2.3-v2.4 talent draft storage format and all existing Azeroth studios
